messages:
sam: Quick internal launch note: Cascade SSE + Toolcall streaming (SSE framing, incremental tool deltas) is GA in hosted us-west-2 and eu-central-1 as of this morning. Docs and migration guide: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/hosted/toolcall-sse. Please skim if you own integrations or customer comms. :tada:

yara: Excellent. Any immediate actions for SDK owners or partner integrators?

sam: SDK owners: please ship small parser updates for SSE event lines (few-line change). Partners: check your proxy layers for long-lived connections; we added connection quotas (see below). We'll surface sample clients in the SDK repo today.

commops: Need a crisp 1-sentence consumer line for the changelog and the status page. Draft?

yara: Draft: "Cascade SSE + Toolcall GA: incremental tool streaming for faster interactive flows and predictable connection quotas." Feel free to shorten.

sam: Key policy/limits: new "stream-conn" concurrent connection quota and a separate streaming token bucket. Default quotas unchanged for small teams. Tenants with >50k streaming tokens/mo will receive an email with suggested limits and opt-up steps.

eng-runtime: Are there any behavioral differences customers should code for?

eng-runtime: Yes: SSE emits typed event frames, e.g. `data: {"t":"delta","tool":"search","payload":{...}}`. Theres also an `end` frame and `error` frame. Tool outputs are incremental so clients should merge deltas. Also added a 90s idle timeout and a 2MB single-message advisory; very large payloads should be chunked.

support-bot: Support playbook created: /docs/internal/toolcall-sse-playbook. Includes reconnection patterns, idempotency token guidance, and common error codes. I'll create a short FAQ for Support rotation.

commops: Ops, can we run a staged rollout and monitor telemetry?

ops-bot: Canary scheduled: 5% traffic in us-west-2 for the next 2 hours, then 20% for 24h if OK. Metrics: stream_conn_count, p99_stream_latency, tool_error_rate, stream_disconnect_rate. Alerts routed to #eng-runtime and #eng-sre.

sam: Migration timeline: legacy streaming (v0) set to deprecate in 30 days, disabled for new customers in 75 days, and disabled cluster-wide in 120 days. We'll send notices and provide a compatibility shim for common HTTP proxies.

yara: Any known regressions? We flagged a minor buffering behavior for single-tool outputs >800KB which might slightly increase end-to-end latency; runtime has a follow-up ticket. Also older corporate proxies may drop long-lived SSE connections by default.

eng-runtime: Follow-up: adding keepalive comments (`: keepalive\n`) is recommended for long idle waits; were adding this to the SDK samples.

commops: I'll prepare the external changelog blurb, update the status page, and schedule a webinar for customers next Wed 11am PT. Support, please prep a short KB for common migration questions.

support-bot: KB draft will be in /docs/internal/toolcall-sse-kb by EOD.

sam: Thanks everyone. I'll post a short deprecation checklist later today and ping teams with active streaming traffic. :rocket:
